messages.每台管理器使用独立凭证，访问凭证 15 分钟到期并定期刷新。可单独撤销；没有共享: Each installation uses its own credential. Access expires after 15 minutes and refreshes periodically. Devices can be revoked separately. Submissions still require an account.
messages.两边都能访问网站和管理业务，单个写入节点可切换。其他站点保存私有数据库副本并转交: All sites provide website and management access through one transferable writer. Followers keep private database copies and forward business requests. Handover pauses operations and verifies a final copy before the new writer starts.

messages.每行填写：名称 | HTTPS 根地址 | 本机私有数据目录。第一行是当前主站。: Enter one site per line: name | HTTPS base URL | private data directory. Put the current primary first. Save each generated configuration on its server and start site mode. Deployment is manual.
messages.资源节点使用 edge 模式；完整站点使用 site 模式。分别保存对应配置文件: Use edge mode for resource nodes and site mode for complete sites. Save each configuration separately and proxy its listener through your TLS entry point.
messages.这是唯一一次完整显示，关闭后将无法再次查看。请保存到受信脚本的配置中；管理器默认: This secret is shown only once. Save it in a trusted script configuration. The manager uses independent rotating device credentials by default.
messages.这些站点通过 HTTPS 提供目录和主题资源。写入节点会随管理员的维护切换更新。: These sites provide catalogs and theme resources over HTTPS. The current writer changes after an administrator completes a handover.
messages.每台设备拥有独立的只读访问凭证，管理器会在到期前自动轮换。投稿需要单独登录账号；: Each device has an independent read credential that the manager refreshes before expiry. Submissions require a separate account login. Revocation stops device access immediately.
messages.请立即复制到管理器设置。刷新凭证也必须保密，关闭后不会再次显示。: Copy this into the manager settings now. Keep the refresh secret private; it will not be shown again.

messages.上传默认 4 路并发，较快入口会领取更多分片；超时或失败会换路。主题包、预览图、: Uploads use four concurrent requests, with faster endpoints handling more chunks and failures switching routes. Packages, previews, avatars and screenshots are merged and verified on the primary before review and publication, then synchronized. Client upload capacity and the link between servers can still limit speed.
messages.账号、作者、关注、统计和审计仍由主站的五个 SQLite 分库统一读写。边缘可暂: The five SQLite databases remain on the primary. Edges may stage upload chunks but cannot publish independently, store login sessions or write databases. Submissions cannot finish while the primary is unavailable.
messages.正在分流上传图片并校验合并…: Uploading images across nodes, verifying and merging…
messages.两台家宽服务器组成自建 CDN：主站统一写入，边缘节点同步主题并从本地磁盘分发。: Build a private CDN on two home connections: writes stay on the primary, while the edge synchronizes and serves themes from disk.
messages.自动选路比较主站到各节点的资源响应时间，主站作为回退；并不代表每位访客的最优线路: Automatic routing compares resource response times from the primary to each edge, with the primary as fallback. This is not a measurement from each visitor. New files are verified before serving; resumed requests stay on the primary.
messages.磁盘缓存按资源摘要保存，更新和撤回随清单同步。浏览器缓存还受短期凭证和同步租约限: Disk objects are keyed by content digest; updates and withdrawals follow the manifest. Browser caching is also limited by download capabilities and sync leases. Public shared caching stays disabled.
messages.每台边缘服务器运行同一程序的 edge 模式，无需复制账号数据库。地址需通过 L: Each edge runs the same binary in edge mode, without account databases. Forward its HTTPS endpoint to the edge listener through Lucky or another TLS proxy.
messages.还没有边缘节点，请先保存主站地址，再添加第二台服务器。: No edge nodes yet. Save the primary URL, then add your second server.
messages.账号、作者、关注、统计和审计仍由主站的五个 SQLite 分库统一读写。边缘节点: Accounts, authors, follows, statistics and audit data remain in the primary's five SQLite databases. Edges only synchronize published files, without login sessions or database writes. Login, submissions and database writes require the primary.
messages.主题同步是秒级最终一致：默认每 5 秒检查，加上文件传输时间。失联超过租约后暂停: Theme sync is eventually consistent: a check every 5 seconds by default, plus transfer time. Edges stop serving when their lease expires. Database disaster recovery still requires separate backups; this is not a database HA cluster.
messages.配置包含该节点的私密密钥。请保存到第二台服务器的独立配置文件，权限设为 0600: This configuration contains the node's private key. Save it as a separate file on your second server with mode 0600. Do not commit it or put it in a public web directory.
messages.运行方式：sukisu-theme-web edge /etc/sukisu-t: Run: sukisu-theme-web edge /etc/sukisu-theme-edge.json. It listens on 127.0.0.1:8081 by default, behind a TLS proxy.
